title: 'There doesn't seem to be a plan in Iran' for the Trump administation
summary: US President Donald Trump said on March 5 it would be a "waste of time" currently to consider sending US ground troops into Iran. This comes amid growing criticism domestically and internationally that the Washington has unclear goals and strategies in Iran, as well as explanations for the war, as it continues attacks in the country.
